origin.description: Receives each chunk and returns nothing.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Receives each chunk and returns nothing.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
res <- read_lines_chunked(I("a\nb"), ChunkCallback$new(function(x, pos) NULL), chunk_size = 1)
if (is.null(res)) "NULL" else "OTHER"
